items.title: Researchers Find Six 0-Days Allowing Unauthorized Takeover of Supermarket Refrigeration Systems
items.description: Six pre-authentication remote code execution flaws were found in the Danfoss AK-SM800A supermarket fridge controller, allowing remote takeover in about an hour, according to Midnight Blue researcher Carlo Meijer. The flaws are stack-based buffer overflows. They affect every firmware version up to and including 5.3.2, and no CVE numbers have been assigned yet. Since October […] The post…

items.title: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Facebook's Android Gallery Access Without Explicit Consent
items.description: Meta was fined €805 million in Italy yesterday over a Facebook for Android feature that suggests photos and videos from users' phone galleries for them to post. The Garante, Italy's data protection authority, found that the feature was enabled by default and that the app accessed Italian users' photos, videos, and related metadata without their explicit consent.
